purpose: Correct over-ornamentation without turning heroine into plain generic uniform
input_roles: old portrait visual identity only, no old prompt reused
prompt:
Create ONE new finished game character portrait, vertical 2:3, of the adult female archer in the supplied images. Image 1 is the original animated sprite identity reference. Image 2 is her existing portrait: use ONLY its red/gold/violet identity, recognizable armor-and-dress vocabulary and pale recurved bow. Rebuild the costume design, action and rendering freshly. Do not copy its standing pose or its dense tiny trim. The aim is a memorable fantasy heroine with elegant moderate ornament — neither overdecorated nor a plain soldier in a sleeveless shirt.

COSTUME DESIGN, the focus of this revision:
Keep a scarlet high ponytail held by a small sculptural gold crest, grouped into a handful of orderly locks, ending around the waist. A fitted deep indigo-violet short battle dress with a clear tailored waist and coherent continuous torso, graceful angled neckline, broad gold armor framing the upper torso rather than separate gold breast cups. A few LARGE designed golden plate forms: sculpted lightweight shoulder guards, articulated forearm guards, knee and shin guards. Use clear bevels and attractive geometric shapes; shoulder and elbow joints must move freely.
The dress has a short overlapping front panel and two broad integrated side panels that end around upper/mid thigh — short structured garment pieces, never long flying strips. Fitted under-shorts are visible only where the action calls for them. Tall fitted dark-violet boots with tasteful broad gold greaves, stable practical soles. Keep the feminine athletic figure and pleasing long leg proportions.
Include a small number of intentional signature details: ONE compact gold-and-red chest emblem; restrained geometric seams; one restrained repeat of its angular motif near the ivory bow grip. The bow has a beautiful strong ivory curve with a few bold gold end/grip fittings, not jagged ornamental spikes. Large violet fabric surfaces remain visible. Design richness comes from silhouette, cut, layering and a coherent motif, not adding lots of bits.
Remove long skirt tails, capes, scarves, ribbons, tassels, dangling chains, loose straps, garters, random jewels and floating ornaments. Hair moves as one controlled arc, not a huge mane. Retain just enough meaningful cloth folds to show the body and motion. Gold softly shaded with selective highlights; no oily gloss. This must still look like a well-designed featured fantasy heroine, not a generic plain tunic uniform.

Pose and image style: Original PC DNF awakening-character-illustration inspired vigorous high-quality anime action drawing, strong outer contour and lighter internal detail, solid volumes and controlled painted shading. A compact three-quarter forward lunge, knees bent at different depths, shoulders twisting against hips, longbow drawn diagonally toward an off-camera target. Face determined and visible. Powerful body rhythm with a beautiful leg/torso silhouette. Bowstring and arrow physically accurate, no extra limbs. Keep enough space to read both feet, head and bow. Quiet subdued cool backdrop with one broad warm sidelight; no decorative background rings, particle storm, text, logo or card frame. Dynamic impact from stance, camera and value structure.
